meta.app: Concussion Care Prototypes (Replit, synced to GitHub)

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Warm paper page ground behind every screen.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Primary ink for headings and body on background and card (10.9:1 light, 13.4:1 dark).

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Off-white panel and card surface that sits on background.

tokens.name: card-foreground
tokens.usage: Text inside cards and panels.

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: Floating surfaces such as menus and popovers.

tokens.name: popover-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on popover.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Restrained hairline borders on panels, cards and dividers. Decorative only: it does not reach 3:1, so never rely on it alone to mark a control.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Botanical green for the one primary action on a screen, progress and selected states.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Label text on primary fills (7.4:1 light, 6.6:1 dark).

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for primary pill buttons. Light value from the app; dark value derived.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Soft sage tint for selected choice cards, info notes and quiet chips.

tokens.name: secondary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on secondary (5.1:1 light).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Muted fills for tracks, skeletons and inactive chips.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Supporting and helper text on muted, card and background (4.8:1 on muted). Darkened from the app's source hue to pass AA; use this for all helper copy.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Clay accent for warm highlights and illustration; supporting role only.

tokens.name: accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on accent (6.4:1 light, 4.8:1 dark).

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Destructive actions such as deleting a day or all recovery data.

tokens.name: destructive-foreground
tokens.usage: Label text on destructive fills (5.0:1).

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Input and textarea borders. Kept exact from source; at 1.3:1 it misses the 3:1 control-border target, so fields also rely on their field fill and label.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring on every interactive element (4.3:1 on card light, 5.3:1 dark).

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: Fill inside inputs, textareas and the consent row, so fields lift off card.

tokens.name: choice-border
tokens.usage: Resting border of choice cards and inner cards.

tokens.name: choice-border-hover
tokens.usage: Choice card border on hover.

tokens.name: selected-border
tokens.usage: Border of a selected choice card, paired with a secondary fill and a check icon (3.6:1 on card).

tokens.name: eyebrow
tokens.usage: Small uppercase section labels on background (4.8:1).

tokens.name: eyebrow-rule
tokens.usage: The short 22px rule drawn before an eyebrow label.

tokens.name: progress-track
tokens.usage: Unfilled part of the step progress bar.

tokens.name: progress-fill
tokens.usage: Filled part of the step progress bar.

tokens.name: notice
tokens.usage: Clay surface for the emergency and new-injury boundary note. Dark value derived.

tokens.name: notice-border
tokens.usage: Border of the boundary note.

tokens.name: notice-title
tokens.usage: Bold title of the boundary note on notice (5.5:1).

tokens.name: notice-body
tokens.usage: Body of the boundary note on notice. Kept exact from source; at 4.2:1 it misses AA for 12px text, so prefer notice-title for any essential wording.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Surface for inline form errors. Dark value derived.

tokens.name: error-foreground
tokens.usage: Error message text on error (5.0:1 light). Always a sentence, never colour alone.

tokens.name: brand-ring
tokens.usage: Outer ring of the Stillwell mark. Used only by the mark.

tokens.name: brand-fill
tokens.usage: Fill of the Stillwell mark. Used only by the mark.

tokens.name: brand-core
tokens.usage: Inner ring of the Stillwell mark. Used only by the mark.

tokens.name: brand-dot
tokens.usage: The clay dot on the Stillwell mark; the one warm point in the identity.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: First chart series.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Second chart series.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Third chart series.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Fourth chart series.

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Fifth chart series.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Page headings at desktop width; the app scales this fluidly from 32px to 56px.

styles.name: display-md
styles.usage: Page headings on phones; the floor of the fluid heading.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The lowercase wordmark beside the mark in headers.

styles.name: label
styles.sample: Choose one or more areas you want to make room for.
styles.usage: Question legends, field labels and card titles.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: I explicitly consent to Stillwell storing the preferences I chose.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: A personal place to notice patterns and shape gentle routines.
styles.usage: Choice descriptions and helper notes, in muted-foreground.

styles.name: micro
styles.sample: These are your chosen areas, not a prescribed care plan.
styles.usage: Fine print, chip labels and reassurance lines.

styles.name: eyebrow-label
styles.usage: Uppercase section labels above headings, in eyebrow, preceded by the eyebrow-rule.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tightest gap, e.g. a title to its caption.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips and small inline items.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between choice cards; icon to text.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Inner card and notice padding; mobile page gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Panel padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Primary button horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Panel padding on desktop; gap between question groups.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Minimum height of buttons, so every tap target is at least 48px.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small numeric inputs.

tokens.name: radius-field
tokens.usage: Inputs, textareas and inline error boxes.

tokens.name: radius-inner
tokens.usage: Inner cards, notices and the consent row inside a panel.

tokens.name: radius-choice
tokens.usage: Selectable choice cards.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: The main content panel of a page.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, step counters and progress bars; every action is a pill.

tokens.name: shadow-panel
tokens.usage: The one soft, low-opacity lift under the main panel. Nothing else casts a shadow.
